latestAction.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs.

aiDescription.summary: The bill permits an emerging growth company to omit acquired‑company financial statements for periods before the earliest audited period shown in its IPO. It amends Securities Act section 7(a)(2) and Exchange Act 12(b)(1)(K) filings and prohibits later requiring those pre‑IPO periods even after the issuer ceases to be an EGC.

impact.summary: The Greenlighting Growth Act lets emerging growth companies (EGCs) and former EGC issuers omit acquired‑company financial statements and 17 C.F.R. §210.3‑05/210.8‑04 disclosures for periods before their earliest audited IPO year. It affects SEC‑registered issuers, auditors, underwriters, and investors.
